# AgentVibes Architecture Diagrams

> Generated: 2026-05-18 | Version: 5.7.7
> These diagrams render inline on GitHub. Click any mermaid.ink link for a standalone PNG.

## Diagram 1: System Architecture Overview

[![System Architecture](https://mermaid.)](https://mermaid.)

**Direct PNG link:** https://mermaid.

```mermaid
graph TB
    subgraph UI["User Interfaces"]
        CC["Claude Code CLI"]
        CD["Claude Desktop / Warp"]
        TUI["Voice Browser TUI"]
    end
    subgraph Entry["Entry Layer"]
        HOOK["SessionStart Hook\nsession-start-tts.sh"]
        MCP["MCP Server\nmcp-server/server.py"]
        SLASH["Slash Commands\n.claude/commands/agent-vibes/"]
    end
    subgraph Core["Core TTS Pipeline"]
        ROUTER["TTS Router\nplay-tts.sh / play-tts.ps1"]
        QUEUE["TTS Queue\ntts-queue.sh"]
        AP["Audio Processor\naudio-processor.sh"]
        BG["Background Music\nbackground-music-manager.sh"]
        FX["Effects Manager\neffects-manager.sh"]
    end
    subgraph Mgmt["Managers"]
        PM["Provider Manager"]
        VM["Voice Manager"]
        PERS["Personality Manager"]
        LANG["Language Manager"]
        SPD["Speed Manager"]
    end
    subgraph Providers["TTS Providers"]
        PIPER["Piper TTS\nLocal Neural"]
        MACOS["macOS Say\nNative"]
        SAPI["Windows SAPI\nNative"]
        WPIP["Windows Piper\nNeural"]
        SSH["SSH Remote"]
        SOP["Soprano\nGradio API"]
    end
    subgraph Config["State and Config"]
        TXT["Config Files\n.claude/*.txt"]
        PFILES["Personalities\n.claude/personalities/"]
        BMAD["BMAD Voices\n.agentvibes/bmad/"]
    end
    AUDIO["Audio Output\nmpv / afplay / SAPI"]
    CC --> HOOK
    HOOK -->|"Injects TTS protocol"| CC
    CD --> MCP
    TUI --> VM & PERS
    MCP --> ROUTER
    SLASH --> ROUTER
    CC -->|"Bash: play-tts.sh"| ROUTER
    ROUTER --> QUEUE --> AP
    AP --> BG & FX
    AP --> PIPER & MACOS & SAPI & WPIP & SSH & SOP
    PM & VM & PERS & LANG & SPD --> TXT
    PERS --> PFILES
    VM --> BMAD
    PIPER & MACOS & SAPI & WPIP --> AUDIO
    SSH & SOP -->|"Remote audio"| AUDIO
```

## Diagram 2: TTS Request Flow (Sequence)

[![TTS Request Sequence](https://mermaid.)](https://mermaid.)

**Direct PNG link:** https://mermaid.

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant U as User
    participant AI as Claude AI
    participant H as SessionStart Hook
    participant R as TTS Router
    participant PM as Provider Manager
    participant PERS as Personality Manager
    participant AP as Audio Processor
    participant P as TTS Provider
    U->>AI: Start Claude Code session
    H->>AI: Inject TTS protocol + settings
    U->>AI: "Check git status"
    AI->>R: Bash: play-tts.sh acknowledgment
    R->>PM: get_active_provider()
    PM-->>R: "piper"
    R->>PERS: get_personality_voice()
    PERS-->>R: "en_US-amy-medium" (sarcastic)
    R->>AP: route to piper with voice
    AP->>P: play-tts-piper.sh text voice
    P-->>AP: synthesize WAV audio
    AP->>AP: apply effects + background music
    AP-->>U: audio plays
    AI->>AI: run git status command
    AI->>R: Bash: play-tts.sh completion
    R->>AP: route to piper
    AP->>P: synthesize
    P-->>U: completion audio plays
```

## Diagram 3: Provider Architecture

[![Provider Architecture](https://mermaid.)](https://mermaid.)

**Direct PNG link:** https://mermaid.

```mermaid
graph LR
    subgraph Router["TTS Router"]
        R["play-tts.sh / play-tts.ps1\nRoutes by active provider"]
    end
    subgraph Local["Local Providers"]
        P1["Piper TTS\nLinux/macOS/WSL\n150+ voices"]
        P2["macOS Say\nmacOS only\n70+ voices"]
        P3["Windows SAPI\nWindows native"]
        P4["Windows Piper\nWindows neural"]
    end
    subgraph Remote["Remote Providers"]
        P5["SSH Remote\nForwards to remote host"]
        P6["Soprano\nGradio API endpoint"]
        P7["Termux SSH\nAndroid audio"]
        P8["AV Receiver\nVoiceless proxy"]
    end
    subgraph State["Provider Selection"]
        T["tts-provider.txt\nProject-local or global"]
        PF["Per-LLM override\naudio-effects.cfg"]
    end
    T --> R
    PF --> R
    R --> P1 & P2 & P3 & P4
    R --> P5 & P6 & P7 & P8
    P1 & P2 --> A1["Local Audio\nmpv / paplay / afplay"]
    P3 & P4 --> A2["Windows Audio\nPowerShell Media"]
    P5 & P6 & P7 & P8 --> A3["Remote Audio\nPlays on target host"]
```
